comments.value: I agree this would be a wonderful thing to add it would keep children from having access to things they don’t need and more

While yes, this is a good idea...creators are typically pretty lazy and also many will get angry responses upon purchase from customers who can't verify due to no vrc+ because it's locked to it currently. I say maybe in the future when it's more standard, but not now

This should also be accompanied by some form of runtime menu modification, such as setting another parameter associated with a control, and if that parameter is false/0 the control is hidden, so when set to `IsAgeVerified` this would hide certain toggles/submenus from such users entirely, though I doubt that's likely to happen given other missing features https://feedback.vrchat.com/avatar-30/p/add-missing-expression-menu-control-types-and-features

would also be good to make it where its client side so if someone eg. a random friend is not verified and its locked behind this parameter they wouldn't be able to see either like the friends parameter

If you could age gate individual toggles, it would be such a confusing mess. How would you know you're missing out on avatar features because you're unverified? Menus could be grayed out, sure, but what if someone else is using the avatar?

I think it's better to just use the existing content warning system, the fallback models will inform you that you're missing out and what is blocking those avatars.

Either an avatar is safe for all ages, or it isn't. No halfsies.
On one hand you could say there is some desync issues, on the other this would help so no youngins see things they shouldn't

Having safety settings on would block animations and break this from working.

Better to just use the existing content gating tags to not show NSFW avatars to unverified players.

@{58c6b8ad227a56787575ebbd|full_name} The content warning system does nothing for people under 18 at this time.

"Age-based Content Gating would automatically enable Content Gating for users under 18 for every filter except Extreme Horror. This was revealed in the 22 November 2023 Developer Update. Due to issues with the system in regards to users having the incorrect Date of Birth on their VRChat account and the way creators label their content, it has been DISABLED as of December 7th 2023. It has been suggested this will be reimplemented with Age Verification in the future, however there is no confirmation as to when or how it will be done."

Source: https://wiki.vrchat.com/wiki/Content_Gating

I 100% back this as well. We need more params like this for creators to use.

I legit was talking about a param like this being added to VRC years before we had age verification.

I want to bump this with the recent video about content gating coming back. If the content tags were built in parameters applied to all avatars when they loaded, it would be a nice way for creators to keep content compliant with the users wishes automatically with hiding or blocking the whole avatar. I would definitely use this if it was a feature. Yeas it would be more work on the creator's end, but it worth it to me and I'm sure others.

details: I think it would be very beneficial to have a native VRC parameter "IsAgeVerified" such that I and other creators can lock certain functionality behind the age filter.
title: Avatars 3.0 Parameter "IsAgeVerified"
